title: Focal 0.1.0 · Alpha 9

qa.real_model_count_note: Completed real Ultra inference is checked through the original saved-audio preview and the new normal Record/Finish primary flow. Fake-decoder and early-cancellation checks are not counted as native inference.
qa.core_and_app_jvm_execution: Cached passing results from the preceding final prebuild
qa.unsigned_release_build: Passed; a separately signed copy received runtime smoke. Distribution and full instrumentation use the debug APK.

heldout_quality.scope: Separate staged Android emulator research build, paired quality only

scope: Ultra is the primary engine for new recordings, with automatic language selection and text saved directly into the note. Up to 30-second windows, 35-second live threshold, remaining durable audio eligible on Pause/Finish. No three-minute recording limit. Legacy Whisper notes preserve their engine and optional separate preview. LLM correction disabled.
pending: Physical phone installation, microphone quality, latency, RAM, battery, thermals and long background capture.

manual.scope: Actual Record/Finish, completion of emulator-input recording without invented words; public JFK saved-tail recovery into the main note, Copy feedback, no second Ultra action for new notes, model settings, light/dark, 200 percent portrait and landscape scrolling to text end. Legacy note rows/manual edits and original audio identical before/after R8 update and exact debug restoration; both new public-fixture original audio hashes preserved.
manual.audio: Host audio disabled; no microphone or audible-playback quality claim.

minified_runtime_smoke.scope: Separate private development-signed R8 copy. Cold model extraction matched all four pinned hashes. Actual primary recovery of public JFK audio saved a full-range transcript in the note, with Copy feedback. Legacy data and original audio preserved. Exact verified debug APK restored; dedicated AVD stopped. Not a full R8 instrumentation run.

independent_review: Sol: application integration, owner-thread decoder, legacy preservation and documentation
Terra: bounded planner, paired scorer, exact APK packaging and all 146 raw outcomes
Astra: critical primary architecture, all 21 quality receipts and 40 source ranges, actual debug/R8 UI and data preservation
iteration_notes: All final builds and 146 tests passed. R8-to-debug replacement initially lacked temporary AVD storage; dedicated AVD reboot resolved the storage error and exact debug restoration succeeded without wiping app data. No model downloads during primary integration or QA.
not_established: Physical-phone microphone and audible playback quality
Natural mixed-language terms, quiet Portuguese and arbitrary long hard-cut boundaries
Phone latency, RAM, battery, thermals and background reliability
Stable production signing and owner UX acceptance

primary_integration_quality.scope: Separate research APK, actual recovery service on previously consumed DEV PCM. Fourteen paired historical Base baselines, four controls, three long inputs; one long input repeats a previous source. Not a new held-out or timing comparison.
